artifact_reason: The bundle's seed record for the group-DM decoy C_ONB_GC states is_private:false (only is_gc/is_mpim true), but the replica's own users.conversations endpoint (step 3) returned is_private:true, is_group:true, is_mpim:true for that same channel — contradicting the seeded ground truth the decoy's fact depends on. The solver read exactly that field and, quite reasonably, concluded the channel was private since the API itself asserted is_private:true. The replica's inconsistent serving of the deciding field (not the solver's diligence) decided the outcome.
note: Step 1 resolved Diego's user id; step 2's conversations.list (member-scoped) found nothing; step 3's users.conversations call for Diego returned C_ONB_GC with is_private:true (conflicting with the bundle's seed of false), and step 4 archived it based on that field. Since the replica itself misreported the deciding fact, this is an artifact rather than a solver skipped-check or misread.
